description: The contract's Known Limitations section acknowledges that PROP-AUTH-010 (concurrent atomicity) 'uses single-threaded Map — true DB-level atomicity requires PostgreSQL SELECT FOR UPDATE'. However, the contract simultaneously claims PROP-AUTH-010 status is 'tested' and the test at integration/auth-flow.test.ts:31-55 uses Promise.allSettled to test concurrency. In a single-threaded JavaScript runtime with synchronous Map operations, both promises execute sequentially (not truly concurrently), so the test does not actually verify atomicity. The test passes only because of single-threaded execution order, not because of any atomic locking mechanism.
